verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm an official llms.txt is served at code.claude.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). The Agent SDK overview page is also available as raw Markdown (.md), and that page points agents to the full documentation index at llms.txt. That is agent-oriented docs delivered directly by the product's own documentation site. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt specifically enumerates the Agent SDK pages (or that an llms-full.txt bundle exists), and independent community corroboration of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
